tools.name: tako_available_data
tools.description:
Find what data Tako holds on an entity or a metric, and the canonical name it holds it under.

Best for: questions about what Tako covers. Put a company, person, or place in `q` to list the metrics tracked on it; put a metric in `q` to list the entities it covers. Add `metric` when you know the meas

tools.name: tako_contents
tools.description:
Fetch the full content behind a url: a web page's text, or an exportable Tako card's data rows. Batch up to 10 urls in one call — each fails on its own.

Fetch only cards that `tako_search` marked `exportable: true`. Set `max_rows` when the recent rows are enough. If a page is long, such as a filing

tools.name: tako_graph_related
tools.description:
Explore what a graph node connects to — its metrics, the entities a metric covers, competitors, industry, index membership, and sources.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "tako_available_data" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
